Before you start

Do I need CAD experience?

No CAD installation is required. You’ll need an image, text or pattern, a few measurements, and a slicer to prepare the exported mesh for your printer.

Will the presets fit my device?

Presets are unverified starting dimensions inherited from the original tool. The cavity is elliptical. Measure your object and test the fit ring first; complex profiles may require CAD.

Does Caviot guarantee printable models?

No. Export checks catch open edges and degenerate triangles, but do not establish physical fit, strength or freedom from self-intersections. Inspect every model in your slicer and test prints before selling physical products.

What is included in the launch edition?

Image and text reliefs, built-in patterns, fit ring exports, STL and OBJ, and portable project files. No subscription or account is required. Future commercial plans have not been set.

Where is my work stored?

Settings and uploaded fonts stay in this browser. Artwork stays in memory until you save a project file. There is no cloud backup. Hosting services may retain normal access logs.
